mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reply ( post_id, user_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, like_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id AS replyId, pr.user_id AS userId, pr.parent_id AS parentId, pr.reply_to_user_id AS targetUserId, pr.content, pr.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(pr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, ui.name AS userName, ui.avatar AS userAvatar FROM post_reply pr JOIN user_info ui ON pr.user_id = ui.id WHERE pr.post_id = #{postId} AND pr.is_deleted = 0 AND ui.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pr.create_time ASC;
